name: Yuuzaki Minori
source:
Minori left her small town to study at a women's college. When she started living alone she changed her hair colour, wore contacts, and changed her shy personality to get a fresh start in the city.

She went to a mixer and meets a mysterious man who simply goes by Reiji. Little did she know that the relationship with him would be one that would introduce her to a whole new world.

[spoiler]She is eventually abandoned by Reiji and the child she gave birth to is taken away by him, due to not knowing his true identity she has no way of finding him or her child.[/spoiler]
